g.text: Force contributions at the end of generation
Potts 1,536 | s = 5, t = 0 | 2,000 saved generated configurations
Final-time measurements only; these panels do not show forces along trajectories.
Boxes: 25–75%; whiskers: 10–90%. Norms are computed before averaging over images.
Visible = pairs + on-site; hidden = global + per-pixel. Components are added as vectors.
Visible–hidden alignment: median cos θ = -0.968. Median net / (visible norm + hidden norm) = 0.126.
One logarithmic colour scale for all maps; grey denotes zero RMS.
Energy forces f = −∇F in normalized coordinates. Reverse-SDE drift = x + 2f; Brownian forcing is not included.
